description: This source file implements the NetworkManager class in C++, providing JSON-RPC method registration, various network management operations (like getting/setting network interfaces, IP settings, WiFi configurations, and internet status), event notifications, and external method calls through an internal network manager interface.

classes.name: NetworkManager
classes.description: Main class implementing network management via JSON-RPC, handling method registration, network operations, and event notifications.

methods.name: void RegisterAllMethods()
methods.description: Registers all JSON-RPC methods to enable remote procedure calls for network management.

methods.name: void UnregisterAllMethods()
methods.description: Unregisters all previously registered JSON-RPC methods.

methods.name: uint32_t SetLogLevel(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Sets the log level for network manager logging.

methods.name: uint32_t GetLogLevel(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level.

methods.name: uint32_t GetAvailableInterfaces(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Retrieves list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: uint32_t GetPrimaryInterface(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Gets the primary network interface.

methods.name: uint32_t SetInterfaceState(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: uint32_t GetInterfaceState(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Checks whether a specific network interface is enabled.

methods.name: uint32_t GetIPSettings(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Retrieves IP configuration for a specified interface.

methods.name: uint32_t SetIPSettings(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Sets IP configuration for a specified interface.

methods.name: uint32_t GetStunEndpoint(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Gets the current STUN server endpoint details.

methods.name: uint32_t SetStunEndpoint(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Configures the STUN server endpoint.

methods.name: uint32_t GetConnectivityTestEndpoints(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Retrieves list of connectivity test endpoints.

methods.name: uint32_t SetConnectivityTestEndpoints(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Sets the connectivity test endpoints.

methods.name: uint32_t IsConnectedToInternet(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Checks the internet connectivity status.

methods.name: uint32_t GetCaptivePortalURI(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Retrieves the URI for captive portal detection.

methods.name: uint32_t GetPublicIP(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Gets the public IP address for a given interface.

methods.name: uint32_t Ping(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Performs an ICMP ping to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: uint32_t Trace(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Performs a traceroute to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: uint32_t SetHostname(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Sets the system hostname.

methods.name: uint32_t StartWiFiScan(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Initiates WiFi scanning for available networks.

methods.name: uint32_t StopWiFiScan(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Stops ongoing WiFi scanning.

methods.name: uint32_t GetKnownSSIDs(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Lists known WiFi SSIDs.

methods.name: uint32_t AddToKnownSSIDs(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Adds a WiFi SSID to known networks.

methods.name: uint32_t RemoveKnownSSID(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Removes a WiFi SSID from known networks.

methods.name: uint32_t WiFiConnect(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Connects to a specified WiFi network.

methods.name: uint32_t WiFiDisconnect(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Disconnects from current WiFi network.

methods.name: uint32_t GetConnectedSSID(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Retrieves current connected SSID info.

methods.name: uint32_t StartWPS(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Starts WPS process for WiFi setup.

methods.name: uint32_t StopWPS(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Stops ongoing WPS process.

methods.name: uint32_t GetWifiState(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Retrieves WiFi interface state.

methods.name: uint32_t GetWiFiSignalQuality(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Gets WiFi signal strength and noise levels.

methods.name: uint32_t GetSupportedSecurityModes(const JsonObject & parameters,JsonObject & response)
methods.description: Lists supported WiFi security modes.

methods.name: void onInterfaceStateChange(const Exchange::INetworkManager::InterfaceState state,const string interface)
methods.description: Event handler for network interface state changes.

methods.name: void onActiveInterfaceChange(const string prevActiveInterface,const string currentActiveinterface)
methods.description: Event handler for active interface changes.

methods.name: void onIPAddressChange(const string interface,const string ipversion,const string ipaddress,const Exchange::INetworkManager::IPStatus status)
methods.description: Event handler for IP address changes.

methods.name: void onInternetStatusChange(const Exchange::INetworkManager::InternetStatus prevState,const Exchange::INetworkManager::InternetStatus currState,const string interface)
methods.description: Event handler for internet connectivity status changes.

methods.name: void onAvailableSSIDs(const string jsonOfScanResults)
methods.description: Event handler for available WiFi SSID scan results.

methods.name: void onWiFiStateChange(const Exchange::INetworkManager::WiFiState state)
methods.description: Event handler for WiFi interface state changes.

methods.name: void onWiFiSignalQualityChange(const string ssid,const int strength,const int noise,const int snr,const Exchange::INetworkManager::WiFiSignalQuality quality)
methods.description: Event handler for WiFi signal quality updates.

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
